Rennes will host Monaco for the 50th time in all competitions, with a win rate their second lowest ratio behind Paris SG among opponents they’ve played at least 10 times at home.

programme.title: Ligue 1 Highlights 2024/25 Week 7
programme.desc: Each Ligue 1 Match week is condensed into a 52-minute highlights show. Every game, goal, penalty, red card and everything in between is squeezed into an action-packed hour to ensure no football fan misses a kick across the game season.

programme.title: Olympique Lyonnais vs Nantes - French Ligue 1 2024/25 Week 7
programme.desc: Marcus Coco is suspended for this match after his dismissal against St Etienne. Since the 2020/21 season, Nantes have won 29% of their away games in Ligue 1 in which he appeared compared to only 11% when he did not. After his first appearance with Lyon against Toulouse last time out, Wilfried Zaha is now the striker with the most touches without having a single one in the opponent's box as well as playing the most minutes without attempting a single shot in Ligue 1 2024/25 among current players.

programme.title: Nice vs PSG - French Ligue 1 2024/25 Week 7
programme.desc: Two of the three duos combining for the most passes in Ligue 1 2024/25 involve Willian Pacho of Paris SG. The Ecuadorian has also attempted and succeeded with the most passes in his own half in the top-flight this season. Marcin Bulka has a 42.9% save rate against his former club Paris SG in Ligue 1, his lowest ratio against an opponent in the top-flight. The Nice goalkeeper nevertheless has the best differential between Expected Goals on target conceded and goals conceded in Ligue 1 this season.

programme.title: Reims vs Montpellier - French Ligue 1 2024/25 Week 7
programme.desc: Reims have lost two of their last three games against Montpellier in Ligue 1, after remaining unbeaten in the previous seven. Unbeaten in their last five Ligue 1 games, a first since October 2022-March 2023, Reims could have 14 points after seven games of a season in the top-flight for the first time since 1974/75.

programme.title: PSG vs Strasbourg - French Ligue 1 2024/25 Week 8
programme.desc: Ousmane Demblélé has been involved in 24 shots following a carry in Ligue 1 2024/25, more than any other player in the big five European leagues. None of his 14 shots have ended in a goal, though three of his 10 chances created have. Andrey Santos is the player who has won the most duels in Ligue 1 this season.

programme.title: Le Havre vs Olympique Lyonnais - French Ligue 1 2024/25 Week 8
programme.desc: Le Havre have won only one of their last eight Ligue 1 games against Lyon, but it was the most recent on January 14, 2024 at the Stade Océane. There has never been a draw between Le Havre and Lyon in Normandy in 16 meetings in the top-flight, the second highest such tally behind Racing CF-Rennes. Le Havre have lost their last four Ligue 1 matches but have not had a longer run of defeats in league games since April-May 2011 in Ligue 2 under Cédric Daury.

programme.title: Sprint Race - FIA Formula 2 Championship -Silverstone Round
programme.desc: The 2025 FIA Formula 2 Championship is an open-wheel racing category serving as the second tier of formula racing in the FIA Global Pathway. The category will be run in support of selected rounds of the 2025 Formula One World Championship. As the championship is a spec series, all teams and drivers competing in the championship will run the same car, the new Dallara F2 2024. Invicta Racing are the reigning Team's Champions.

programme.title: Main Race Qualifying - F1 Qatar Airways British Grand Prix - 2025
programme.desc: The battle for pole position heats up at Silverstone as drivers push to the limit in qualifying. With changing track conditions and high-speed corners, securing a front-row start is critical for success in Sunday’s race at this historic British circuit.

programme.title: Practice 1 - F1 Qatar Airways British Grand Prix - 2025
programme.desc: The Formula 1 weekend begins at Silverstone with the first practice session. Teams take to the historic British circuit to test setups, assess tyre performance, and gather crucial data ahead of qualifying. A key opportunity to evaluate early pace and upgrades.

programme.title: Qualifying - FIA Formula 2 Championship -Silverstone Round
programme.desc: The 2025 FIA Formula 2 Championship is an open-wheel racing category serving as the second tier of formula racing in the FIA Global Pathway. The category will be run in support of selected rounds of the 2025 Formula One World Championship. As the championship is a spec series, all teams and drivers competing in the championship will run the same car, the new Dallara F2 2024. Invicta Racing are the reigning Team's Champions.

programme.title: Practice 2 - F1 Qatar Airways British Grand Prix - 2025
programme.desc: Drivers return to the track for a longer afternoon session under evolving conditions. With more rubber laid down, teams focus on race simulations and fine-tuning balance for both qualifying and Sunday’s main event at the iconic Silverstone circuit.

programme.title: Sprint Race - FIA Formula 3 Championship - Silverstone Round
programme.desc: The 2025 FIA Formula 3 Championship is an open-wheel racing category serving as the third tier of formula racing in the FIA Global Pathway. The category will be run in support of selected rounds of the 2025 FIA Formula One World Championship. As the championship is a spec series, all teams and drivers competing in the championship will run the same car, the Dallara F3 2025. Prema Racing are the reigning Teams' Champions

programme.title: Practice 3 - F1 Qatar Airways British Grand Prix - 2025
programme.desc: The final practice session at Silverstone gives teams one last chance to refine setups before qualifying. With fuel loads lowered and grip increasing, this session offers a glimpse at true pace and race-day readiness on one of F1’s most demanding circuits.

programme.title: Sprint Race - FIA Formula 2 Championship -Silverstone Round

programme.title: GP Confidential 2025 Magazine
programme.desc: Explore the sporting secrets of F1. Across 25 episodes and in crisp 3D animations, we analyses the technical details, which decide which teams make the most of the rules - and which need to go back to the drawing board. Complemented by features on historical milestones as well as race previews - GP Confidential is the perfect treat for any F1 fan.

programme.title: Feature Race - FIA Formula 2 Championship -Silverstone Round

programme.title: GOODYEAR FIA European Truck Racing 2025-Slovakiaring
programme.desc: 1,000 horsepower - 0 concern for the heir trucks' integrity. This is the winning formula of the FIA Truck Racing Championship. These matadors deliver thrilling action across four races per event in an oversized battle royal! Forget tactics—prepare for raw, tough racing and plenty of collisions!

programme.title: Sprint Race - FIA Formula 3 Championship - Silverstone Round

programme.title: Main Race - F1 Qatar Airways British Grand Prix - 2025
programme.desc: The lights go out at Silverstone for the main event of the weekend. Drivers take on the high-speed straights and legendary corners of one of Formula 1’s most historic tracks, with crucial points and national pride at stake in this iconic British Grand Prix.

programme.title: DTM Show 2025-Zandvoort
programme.desc: DTM. The embodiment of Motorsport tradition. Having just turned 40, the DTM combines a unique fascination and familiarity with an unmistakable dynamic, signified by the rebranding with a new logo! Seven different manufacturers – ten different winners on six brands (Audi, BMW, Mercedes, Lamborghini, Porsche and Ferrari) through twelve races are but one testament to the unique competitive balance that makes every DTM weekend a revelation! England / Germany
programme.desc: CLAP FINDING IN APOTOTHEMENT AT THE EURO ESPERS 2025: Germany defies England in the final in Bratislava for electric revenge between two European football giants. Beaten by the Mannschaft in the group phase (2-1), the Young Lions of Lee Carsley have since raised the cursor. Brilliant against Spain (1-3) in quarters, then solid against the Netherlands (2-1), they arrived launched, carried by a sparkling Harvey Elliott: 3 goals and 1 decisive pass in the matches with direct elimination. But Germany impresses even more. Intouchables in hens (9 points), Antonio Di Salvo's men first snatched their place in half against Italy (3-2 A.P.), before offset France (3-0). With 14 goals scored in 5 games, their attack is formidable, led by Nick Woltemade, top scorer of the tournament (6 goals). Between a revengeful England and a Germany in full control, this final promises intensity, talent and fireworks.

programme.title: Portugal / France
programme.desc: The 2025 Euro Espoirs opens with a summit. In search of a title that has been fleeing them since 1988, Gérald Batic's blueberries are starting their campaign against Portugal, one of the big favorites in the tournament. Despite Hugo Ekitike's major absences, Arnaud Kalimuendo or Maghnes Akliouche, the tricolor attack looks great with Mathys Tel, Mathis Abline, Wilson Odobert and Thierno Barry who offer a varied and explosive offensive palette. Behind them, the duo Diouf - the lens regulates the tempo with accuracy, while Guillaume remains assures with authority in the hot moments. An eleven young but formidably structured, determined to mark its entry territory. Portugal is advancing the bombed chest. Boosted by the blossoming of the Geovany Quenda phenomenon, a new jewel of Chelsea, the Seleção also relies on the finesse of Mateus Fernandes and the solidity of Samuel Soares in the cages to win. This shock in Trencin promises to be a full -scale test for the two nations.
